overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0001104659-26-019392), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities: 'Purchases of property and equipment' $(202,928) thousand FY2025 / $(123,991) thousand FY2024 / $(604) thousand six months ended Dec 31, 2023; 'Deposit paid to purchase miners and mining equipment' $(14,000) thousand FY2025 / $(39,611) thousand FY2024; 'Additions to intangible assets' $(1,011) thousand FY2025 / $(286) thousand FY2024. Full-calendar-2023 legs from the prior Form 10-K (filed 2025-03-03, accession 0001558370-25-001996) tagged facts for 2023-01-01..2023-12-31, the same period basis as the engine's 2023-12-31 history row: Purchases of property and equipment $1,542,000 + Deposit paid to purchase miners and mining equipment $966,000 = $2,508,000. XBRL tags (none of them in the engine's capex candidate list): PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment, PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets, PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads, because Hut 8 files its equipment capex only as PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment (the cash-flow line 'Purchases of property and equipment') plus PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets (the line 'Deposit paid to purchase miners and mining equipment') plus PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets ('Additions to intangible assets'). True per-year totals: FY2023 $2,508,000, FY2024 $163,888,000, FY2025 $217,939,000. The engine applies this single value to every missing period; it is the median of the three filed years (the FY2024 figure). Against the true per-year figures it overstates FY2023 capex by $161,380,000 (conservative direction — lowers that year's OE) and understates FY2025 capex by $54,051,000 (flatters the latest year; noted, not hidden — on per-year filed capex the median base is -$2.51/sh vs the override-applied -$3.43/sh, and both are deeply negative, so the tier does not turn on the difference). Excluded, with reasons: 'Bitcoin purchased' ($405,147,000 FY2025) and 'Other digital asset purchased' ($25,000,000 FY2025) are purchases of digital assets held as treasury/investment, presented separately by the filer — asset purchases, not capex; 'Deposits for future sites' ($162,691,000 FY2025, custom tag) is a deposit — no property or equipment was acquired — and including it would not change the median (it is a single-year spike; the median of $2,508,000 / $163,888,000 / $380,630,000 is still $163,888,000).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 45.1%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

Full-calendar-2023 legs from the prior Form 10-K (filed 2025-03-03, accession 0001558370-25-001996) tagged facts for 2023-01-01..2023-12-31, the same period basis as the engine's 2023-12-31 history row: Purchases of property and equipment $1,542,000 + Deposit paid to purchase miners and mining equipment $966,000 = $2,508,000. XBRL tags (none of them in the engine's capex candidate list): PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment, PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets, PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
